 JJ Redick lacks words trying to describe Luka Doncic's recent dominance 
 2026-11-07 06:47 
 Following a 53-point masterpiece in the Lakers' win against Portland, Luka Doncic pushed his season average to 40.1 points per game. His historic start has rewritten NBA record books, leaving Lakers head coach JJ Redick admitting he has run out of words to describe his superstar.
 Credit: Getty Images via AFP - Scanpix 
 Credit Getty Images via AFP - Scanpix 
 Credit Getty Images via AFP - Scanpix 
 Add us on 
 Add us on 
 As the Los Angeles Lakers dismantled the Portland Trail Blazers 124-118 , head coach JJ Redick struggled to describe Luka Doncic 's recent performance.

 In Friday's game, Doncic scored 53 points and added five rebounds alongside five assists to raise his current season points average to 40.1 points per game.
 After the game, Redick was asked if he is running out of superlatives to describe Luka. He said "sure" and offered a slightly more in-depth response after a brief pause.
 "I'm gonna just sit around and will gather one day, come up with more superlatives so I have more words ready. But for now, I don't have any words," the Lakers coach answered .
 Doncic's insane scoring start continues
 Luka Doncic Credit Getty Images via AFP-Scanpix The Slovenian superstar has entered the Lakers' history books as only the fourth player in franchise history to score 40 points in fourth consecutive games, joining Elgin Baylor , Kobe Bryant and George Mikan.
 Doncic's 361 points through the first nine games to start the season is the most in the modern NBA and the most since Wilt Chamberlain scored 472 in the 1962-63 season.
 Luka has also recorded his 11th career 50-point game passing  Kareem Abdul-Jabbar and tying Allen Iverson for 10th most in NBA history.
 Doncic has also recorded his 62nd game with at least 40 points, five rebounds and five assists. He ties Michael Jordan for the most such games in NBA history, passing LeBron James in Wilt Chamberlain in the process.
